# streamtime_kafka_topic (Resource)

A topic on a Kafka cluster. Changes are applied to the cluster at once. Partitions can be added but never removed; destroying the topic deletes its messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_kafka_topic" "payments" {
  kafka              = streamtime_kafka.orders.identifier
  name               = "payments"
  partitions         = 6
  replication_factor = 3

  config = {
    "retention.ms"   = "604800000"
    "cleanup.policy" = "delete"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kafka` (String) Identifier of the streamtime_kafka cluster the topic is on. Changing it creates a new topic.
- `name` (String) Topic name: letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes, up to 249 characters. Changing it creates a new topic.
- `partitions` (Number) Number of partitions. It can only be raised; lowering it is an error.
- `replication_factor` (Number) Copies of each partition kept on different brokers. Changing it creates a new topic, deleting its messages.

### Optional

- `config` (Map of String) Topic settings, for example retention.ms or cleanup.policy. Only the settings listed here are managed; removing one returns it to the cluster's default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <kafka>/<name>. Import with the same value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <kafka>/<topic name>.
terraform import streamtime_kafka_topic.payments orders/payments
```
